description: Logistic regression on DINOv2-large features (CLS token + mean patch token) of Grounding DINO hand and face crops; flags an image when its highest crop probability exceeds threshold. Feature standardisation is folded into coef and intercept.
trained_on: VisionBench round 7 (user-reviewed): 261 defect crops, 772 clean crops from 149 images (defect boxes plus the user's crop calls)
chosen_by: VisionBench defect_round10.py: rule fixed before the run (a5efb20), AUC minus the CLIP probe's 95% interval above zero
